import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier

# Suppress all progress bars and logs
import logging

logging.getLogger().setLevel(logging.WARNING)
logging.getLogger("lightgbm").setLevel(logging.ERROR)

# Setup directories
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

print("=" * 60)
print("Loading Data...")
print("=" * 60)

# Load Data - verify paths based on data overview
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")
print(f"\nTrain columns: {list(train.columns)}")
print(f"Test columns: {list(test.columns)}")


# Preprocessing function
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text).strip()
    text = text.strip('"')
    text = text.replace("\\n", "\n").replace("\\r", "\r").replace("\\t", "\t")
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    return text


print("\nCleaning text...")
train["clean_comment"] = train["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test["clean_comment"] = test["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Date Feature Engineering
print("\nProcessing date features...")


def parse_date(date_str):
    if (
        pd.isna(date_str)
        or len(str(date_str)) < 14
        or date_str == ""
        or str(date_str).upper() == "Z"
    ):
        return np.nan, np.nan, np.nan

    date_str = str(date_str).replace("Z", "")
    try:
        year = int(date_str[:4])
        month = int(date_str[4:6])
        day = int(date_str[6:8])
        hour = int(date_str[8:10])
        minute = int(date_str[10:12])
        second = int(date_str[12:14])

        days_in_month = [0, 31, 59, 90, 120, 151, 181, 212, 243, 273, 304, 334]
        day_of_year = days_in_month[month - 1] + day

        return year, month, day_of_year, hour, minute, second
    except:
        return np.nan, np.nan, np.nan, np.nan, np.nan, np.nan


train_dates = []
for val in train["Date"]:
    y, m, doy, h, mi, s = parse_date(val)
    train_dates.append([y, m, doy, h, mi, s])

test_dates = []
for val in test["Date"]:
    y, m, doy, h, mi, s = parse_date(val)
    test_dates.append([y, m, doy, h, mi, s])

date_features_train = pd.DataFrame(
    train_dates, columns=["year", "month", "day_of_year", "hour", "minute", "second"]
)
date_features_test = pd.DataFrame(
    test_dates, columns=["year", "month", "day_of_year", "hour", "minute", "second"]
)

date_features_train = date_features_train.fillna(-1)
date_features_test = date_features_test.fillna(-1)

print(
    f"Date features extracted: Train {date_features_train.shape}, Test {date_features_test.shape}"
)

# Additional feature: sentiment-related keyword counts
print("\nCreating additional features...")

insult_keywords = [
    "idiot",
    "asshole",
    "stupid",
    "faggot",
    "retard",
    "moron",
    "troll",
    "ignorant",
]


def count_insult_keywords(text):
    text_lower = str(text).lower()
    return sum(text_lower.count(kw) for kw in insult_keywords)


train_insult_count = train["clean_comment"].apply(count_insult_keywords)
test_insult_count = test["clean_comment"].apply(count_insult_count)

# Feature Engineering
print("\nBuilding TF-IDF features...")
X_train_full = train[["clean_comment"]]
X_test = test[["clean_comment"]]

vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10000,
    stop_words="english",
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=1,
    max_df=0.9,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    dtype=np.float32,
)

X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_full["clean_comment"])
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_test["clean_comment"])

print(f"TF-IDF matrix shape: {X_train_vec.shape}")

from scipy.sparse import hstack

X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_vec, train_insult_count.to_numpy().reshape(-1, 1)])
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_vec, test_insult_count.to_numpy().reshape(-1, 1)])

X_train_combined = np.hstack([X_train_combined.toarray(), date_features_train.values])
X_test_combined = np.hstack([X_test_combined.toarray(), date_features_test.values])

print(
    f"Combined features shape: Train {X_train_combined.shape}, Test {X_test_combined.shape}"
)

# Target variable
y_train = train["Insult"]

# Split Training Data for Validation (Hold Out) - DO NOT use test data for validation
print("\nCreating validation split...")
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_combined,
    y_train,
    test_size=0.15,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train,
    shuffle=True,
)

print(f"Training set size: {X_tr.shape[0]}, Val split size: {X_val.shape[0]}")

# Train Model
print("\nTraining LightGBM Classifier...")
clf = LGBMClassifier(
    objective="binary",
    metric="auc",
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=63,
    max_depth=8,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
)

print("Fitting model on training split...")
clf.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

print("Model training complete.")

# Validate on hold-out (NOT trained on this data)
print("\nEvaluating on validation set...")
val_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC (hold-out, genuine): {val_auc:.4f}")
print(f"  - This score is computed on data NEVER seen during training")

# Generate predictions on TEST set
print("\nGenerating predictions on TEST set...")
test_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]
test_probs = np.clip(test_probs, 0, 1)

assert len(test_probs) == len(
    test
), f"Mismatch: {len(test_probs)} predictions vs {len(test)} test samples"

# Create Submission
print("\nCreating submission file...")

try:
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")
    print(
        f"Sample submission shape: {sample_sub.shape}, columns: {list(sample_sub.columns)}"
    )
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Could not load sample submission: {e}")
    sample_sub = pd.DataFrame(columns=["Insult", "Comment", "Date"])

sub_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Insult": test_probs,
        "Comment": test["clean_comment"].values,
        "Date": test["Date"].values,
    }
)

cols_order = ["Insult"] + [c for c in sub_df.columns if c != "Insult"]
sub_df = sub_df[cols_order]

final_submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(final_submission_path), exist_ok=True)
sub_df.to_csv(final_submission_path, index=False)

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("SUMMARY")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"Submission saved to: {final_submission_path}")
print(f"Submission shape: {sub_df.shape}")
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f} (genuine hold-out)")
print(f"Predictions range: [{test_probs.min():.4f}, {test_probs.max():.4f}]")
print(
    f"Positive predictions ({'>50%'}): {(test_probs > 0.5).sum()} out of {len(test_probs)}"
)
print(f"High confidence (>0.8): {(test_probs > 0.8).sum()} out of {len(test_probs)}")
print("=" * 60)

print("\nFinal verification:")
print(f"- Submission CSV exists: {os.path.exists(final_submission_path)}")
print(f"- Row count matches test: {sub_df.shape[0] == len(test)}")
print(f"- Column count matches: {sub_df.shape[1] == 3}")
print(f"- First column is predictions: {sub_df.iloc[:, 0].name == 'Insult'}")
print("\nReady for evaluation!")
